findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice mcqs for Unit 10 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 50 questions numbered 1-50; by section: 10.1 26, 10.2 14, 10.3 10. Keys: {'a': 12, 'b': 12, 'c': 13, 'd': 13}.

Covers 10.1 (principal and general solutions, reference angle and quadrants, periods, quadratic equations in one ratio, extraneous roots after squaring), 10.2 (graphical solution, range limits, sign test, symmetry, branches of tan x) and 10.3 (angles of elevation, subtended angles with the tan^-1 difference formula, projectile range) in book order, with new equations and data; no exercise question or book example is repeated. Book corrections followed (4pi/3 + 2n pi in Example 1, five roots of cos x = x/8, y = x/2 in Figure 10.1). Every key and distractor was checked by computation (check10.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
